Studio is the planned authoring workflow (VISION.md section 4): how an
author goes from one concept's source to its figure, animation, slides and
interactive page.

## Purpose

To make "define once, render everywhere" a routine an author can follow,
without re-drawing the same concept in each medium.

## Which modules it uses

The core model (circuit schema, symbol pack, simulation) and the renderers.

## Status

Not started. It isn't scheduled in VISION.md section 6's immediate
targets. This page will describe it when work begins.
